description: This file implements the transport layer for integrating the Pipecat framework with the HeyGen platform, enabling real-time audio/video communication with avatars. It defines classes for input/output transports, session management, and event handling specific to HeyGen.

classes.name: HeyGenInputTransport
classes.description: Handles incoming audio streams and events from HeyGen conversations, managing audio capture from participants.

classes.name: HeyGenOutputTransport
classes.description: Manages outgoing audio and event frames to HeyGen conversations, including handling interruptions and speech state changes.

classes.name: HeyGenParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for enabling/disabling audio input/output in HeyGen transport.

classes.name: HeyGenTransport
classes.description: Main transport class that manages session initialization, participant connection/disconnection, and provides input/output transport instances for HeyGen integration.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Returns the input transport instance for receiving media and events.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the output transport instance for sending media and events.

methods.name: _on_participant_disconnected
methods.description: Handles participant disconnection events, excluding the 'heygen' participant.

methods.name: _on_participant_connected
methods.description: Handles participant connection events, initiating audio capture for new participants.

methods.name: _on_client_connected
methods.description: Handles client connection events, invoking registered event handlers.

methods.name: _on_client_disconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, invoking registered event handlers.
